description: This file is a Java class that functions as a centralized handler for exceptions in a Spring Boot REST API. It maps various exceptions to standardized API error responses, ensuring consistent error communication.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST Controller Advice class that handles various exceptions occurring within the application and maps them to appropriate HTTP responses with detailed API error messages.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Helper method to construct a ResponseEntity<ApiError> with specific HTTP status, code, message, request URI, and optional additional details.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles ResourceNotFoundException by returning a 404 Not Found with error details.

methods.name: handleConflict
methods.description: Handles ResourceConflictException by returning a 409 Conflict with conflict details.

methods.name: handleBodyValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors from method argument validation, returning a 400 Bad Request with validation error details.

methods.name: handleConstraintViolations
methods.description: Handles validation constraint violations, returning a 400 Bad Request indicating validation failure.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrity
methods.description: Fallback handler for database integrity violations, returning a 409 Conflict to indicate data conflicts.

methods.name: handleUnknown
methods.description: Fallback handler for any unexpected exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error.
